title: Shaped-rotor gravitational communication
description: Simulation code and numerical data for rotating-mass Newtonian gravitational communication: source fields, constrained modulation, information rates and torque-amplitude Pareto search, a joint receiver combining a streaming sequence detector with a nonbinary GF(512) LDPC decoder, packet BER qualification, simulated preamble acquisition and tracking, ground-motion mitigation, a comparison with the rotating-bar experiment of Brack et al. (2023), steel and tungsten rotor mechanics, tone-count studies, arrays, and finite-size magnetic links through conducting barriers. Includes the numerical data archives in datasets/. See docs/RELEASE_v0.6.0.md for scope, reproducibility and modeling limitations.
